username.title: Eufy account email
username.description: Optional when every configured vacuum uses local mode. Required for account Cloud/MQTT discovery.

password.title: Eufy account password
password.description: Optional when every configured vacuum uses local mode. Required for account Cloud/MQTT discovery.

enableMatter.title: Enable native Matter vacuum
enableMatter.description: When Homebridge 2.x Matter is enabled for this bridge, expose each RoboVac as a native Matter Robotic Vacuum Cleaner. Automatically falls back to the HomeKit switch + battery accessory when Matter is unavailable or registration fails.

pollInterval.title: Status refresh interval (seconds)
pollInterval.description: Refresh interval for HomeKit or Matter vacuum state and battery information.

deviceModel.title: Eufy model code
deviceModel.description: Optional, for example T2272 or T2276. Recommended for manually configured local devices.

ip.title: Legacy local IP
ip.description: Required with localKey for local mode.

localKey.title: Legacy local key
localKey.description: Required with IP for local mode.

mapId.title: Default Eufy map ID
mapId.description: Optional map ID used for manual Matter room mappings. Find it in debug logs when the transport exposes map metadata.

rooms.title: Matter room mappings
rooms.description: Manual fallback for transports that do not expose Eufy room names. Room IDs must match the IDs in the Eufy map and remain stable until the map is recreated.

mapId.title: Map ID override
mapId.description: Optional per-room map ID; otherwise the device-level mapId is used.
